title: stage-needs-held-two-animals
intention: Split the two different things that had been sharing the ticket field `stage_needs`: a WORKFLOW stage's measured dependency ledger (which keeps the name) and PROSE addressed to a leg of the CHART chain (which becomes `chart_notes`, gated by the chart, which owns its own leg names). Give the chart's seven legs one written-down home so a gate can validate against it without tracing imports.
why: The suite's one standing red read as a single stale ticket with a stage called 'orient'. It was not. MEASURED 2026-07-30 across the live corpus: 33 chart-keyed PROSE entries in 12 tickets, and 7 workflow-keyed LEDGER entries (lists of {need, marks}) in 6 — one field, two animals, and the SHAPES are what proved it rather than any argument. cairn/tools/base/needs.py was RIGHT to refuse the prose; its message named only the workflow vocabulary, so the finding pointed at a stage name instead of at a field carrying two meanings. The collision was invisible because 'stage needs' reads plausibly in the chart's dialect too — the term survived while the meaning was swapped under it (memory: words-kept-meanings-replaced). And ONE red was reported when TWELVE tickets were in the same condition, because the live scan raised on the first offender and the remaining eleven sat behind alphabetical order; that is the second defect this ticket pays for, and the more expensive one.
traces_to: Law 1 (the resolver is spent on the novel) — the chain order was implicit in each stage module's imports, so 'what are the legs, in order' could only be answered by re-deriving it; a gate cannot afford that, and now nobody pays it
Law 4 (physics, not policy) — the split is a gate that refuses, in both directions, not a note asking authors to be careful
Law 6 (exactly one owner) — the chart owns its leg vocabulary, so the chart_notes gate berths in cairn/machines/chart/; base does not import chart, it names the field in a string
Law 7 (loud AND complete at diagnostic surfaces) — the scan now reports EVERY offender on its initial pass; re-running to gather the rest is what cost a day here
I-complete-diagnostic-on-first-pass — Akien's proven method, and this is the case that shows what a first-failure report costs even when it is technically correct

proves_green.BUILDME: the two gates refuse in BOTH directions — a workflow stage name under chart_notes, and a bare string under stage_needs — and each refusal names the other field, so a reader who lands on either is one rename from right and the message says which way
proves_green.PROVEME: cairn/machines/chart/proofs/test_chart_notes.py green under the tester with the netns seal measured; VALIDATION beside the code at cairn/machines/chart/validations/test_chart_notes.json
proves_green.PROVED: the corpus itself: test_no_ticket_still_keys_a_workflow_NEED_by_a_chart_leg scans every live ticket, so the migration is proved by what is on disk rather than by memory of having done it

falsifier.proves_red: A chart leg under `stage_needs`, or a workflow stage under `chart_notes`, must be REFUSED — the collision cannot re-form under either name. A note must be PROSE: a list of {need, marks} under a leg is refused, because a chart note that grew marks would start pretending to be measured. The leg list must have exactly one home — if cairn/machines/chart/chain.py's STAGES and cairn/machines/chart/dial.py's STAGE_FIELDS can disagree, 'written down once' is a claim and not a fact. And the scan must report EVERY offender on its first pass: a scan that reported one would satisfy `len(findings) > 0` and still hide two, which is precisely the failure this ticket exists to pay for.
falsifier.horizon: The corpus tooth holds against the collision re-forming, and needs no clock. WHAT IS NOT WATCHED, stated rather than left silent: whether anyone ever writes a NEW chart_notes block, or whether the field is a museum for 33 migrated entries while future casters keep putting chart prose into `state`. The live tooth cannot detect that — the 12 migrated tickets keep it green forever. Look again once a dozen tickets have been cast since 2026-07-30; if none carries chart_notes, the field failed and the reason is worth more than the field was.
